interpretation.success: Given a leak onset, five hours of sensor residuals reduce a nine-junction network to a top-three candidate set containing the true node 86.4% of the time, and the top guess is within two graph hops 97.0% of the time.
interpretation.limitation: Net1 is a small nine-junction benchmark and the benchmark supplies the true event onset. This proves the localization mechanism, not utility-scale field readiness.
interpretation.next_iteration: Run a fresh end-to-end Net1 benchmark in which the alert detector supplies the timestamp used by localization, so detection delay/false alerts and localization error are measured together.
